incident-bot: PAGER: metering telemetry delay detected — token emitter lag in eu-west-1. Severity: Sev2. Auto-created thread 1782000000

marta (oncall): seeing the alert. can someone confirm scope? which services impacted?

kevin (sre): looking at zk: emitter-consumer group shows backlog ~12k messages, consumer lag rising since 11:42 UTC.

kevin (sre): command i ran: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-prod:9092 --describe --group emitter-consumer` output: `CURRENT-OFFSET  2345678  LAG 12345`

sasha (billing-eng): confirmed gaps in token tallies for a subset of accounts — preliminary metric shows ~15% drop in reported tokens for last 20m compared to expected. overage flags may be suppressed but some customers already got alerts.

jamie (support): got 2 customer messages about delayed invoices. hold on notifications? we should avoid spamming customers if counts are incomplete.

marta (oncall): action plan: 1) mute overage alerts for affected window (eu-west-1) 2) kick recon/backfill job 3) if consumer not catching up within 15m, escalate to infra. assigning kevin to consumer, sasha to billing recon, jamie to customer comms.

kevin (sre): rebalanced partition assignment to add consumer pod: `kubectl scale deployment/emitter-consumer -n prod --replicas=6`. consumer pods spawned, tails show progress: `processed 4k msgs in 30s`

sasha (billing-eng): starting reconcile job: `python scripts/reconcile_tokens.py --from 2026-03-18T11:40Z --to now --region eu-west-1 --run-backfill` kicked at 1782000020. will stream progress in thread. expected runtime ~12m.

jamie (support): message template for customers: "We're investigating a short delay in usage reporting for EU region. No billing changes are expected while we backfill data. We'll follow up when counts are reconciled." ok to send?

liz (product): confirm — send as proactive update, include ETA 30m and link to status page.

kevin (sre): consumer backlog trending down to 3.2k at 1782000038. CPU on consumer nodes briefly spiked to 85% — scaling helped.

sasha (billing-eng): reconcile progress: 30% done, found emitter gap caused by transient 503 responses from emitter-proxy between 11:41-11:44. backfill inserting missing token events. preliminary estimate: <0.5% of customers will see any invoice delta > $1.

marta (oncall): good. jamie, send customer notice now. sasha, when backfill completes, we will re-run billing validator and re-enable alerts.

jamie (support): sent message to affected customers and posted status update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1782-metering-delay

incident-bot: AUTOMATION: Alerts for "billing.overage" suppressed for tags region:eu-west-1 until 1782000365 by marta (oncall).

sasha (billing-eng): backfill finished at 1782000060. re-running validator: `./bin/validate_billing --window 11:40-12:00 --region eu-west-1` -> no regressions apart from expected deltas; ready to re-enable alerts.

marta (oncall): re-enabled alerts at 1782000065. post-incident notes: root cause = transient 503s from emitter-proxy causing consumer checkpoint lag. next steps: 1) harden emitter-proxy retry logic (sasha) 2) add consumer autoscale on lag (kevin) 3) add a quick reconcile playbook and a muted-alert runbook for billing (marta + sasha).

liz (product): will draft customer-facing postmortem + impact summary. assigning to sasha for numbers.

jamie (support): closing customer comms loop now; no escalations.

kevin (sre): putting follow-ups in the oncall board.

marta (oncall): thanks all. closing thread."
